verdicts.summary: The ignored-workspace path reads as consistent. The main remaining risk is how real git answers `check-ignore --no-index .`. I could not run git or read its source, so I could not confirm that case.
evidence: apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:693-738 (filterIgnoredPaths runs `check-ignore --no-index -z --stdin` with no commitEnv, and exit 0 or 1 is accepted)
apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:865-966 (the scratch index is always rebuilt from HEAD, so the staged-only seeding at 973-1009 is needed)
apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:973-1024 (the additions diff reads the real index because it has no env; update-index and ls-files use commitEnv, so they act on the scratch index)
apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:1151 (the scratch index is removed in ensuring)
apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:1159-1245 (restore runs `clean -fd` without -x, so untracked files in an ignored dir are not deleted)
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/CheckpointService.ts:287-296, 403-436, 520-530 (a skipped checkpoint becomes missing or has no ref, and restore refuses non-ready checkpoints)
apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:426-431 (the hardened config does not alter the excludes configuration)
verdicts.missing: A real git run is needed for three cases. (1) When cwd is the repository root and the root .gitignore contains `*`, does `git check-ignore --no-index .` report `.` as ignored? If it does, `workspaceIgnored` becomes true for a root workspace. A root workspace with no tracked files is then skipped as 'missing', where `add -A` used to give an empty-tree checkpoint. (2) Does `git update-index --index-info` take root-relative paths when run from a subdirectory? The added tests suggest it does. (3) Does `check-ignore --no-index` behave the same across the supported git versions?

verdicts.summary: If a workspace is ignored after a baseline was captured while it was not ignored, the baseline holds untracked files. The next turn checkpoint is 'ready' but tracked-only, so the turn diff would list the baseline's untracked files as deleted. I read the code path that produces this, but not the diff consumers.
evidence: apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:969-1038 (ignored workspace stages with `add -u` only, so untracked files are dropped from the tree)
apps/server/src/orchestration-v2/CheckpointService.ts:438-494 (diffCheckpoints runs between the previous ref and the new ref, with no check that the two captures used the same mode)
verdicts.missing: I did not check whether any consumer filters these deletions, and the scenario needs the agent or user to add the workspace to the parent's .gitignore mid-thread. That makes it a rare edge case, low severity at most.
